automation.menuHint: Configure Bane of Azeroth automation by feature.
automation.elementalTotemHint: Automate selection, placement, replacement, ownership, and cleanup.
automation.demonHint: Automate selection, placement, replacement, ownership, duration, and cleanup.
automation.mageBrillianceHint: Automatically manage Sense Magic and other Mage's Brilliance rules.
automation.evokersLegacyHint: Reduce spell WP costs for characters with Evoker's Legacy.
automation.warStompHint: Add and automate the Tauren War Stomp Brawling attack.
automation.eyeBeamHint: Automate Eye Beam targeting, WP cost, automatic hit, and damage.
automation.serenityHint: Increase embedded Unarmed weapon damage to D10 while Monk's Serenity is present, and update the actor's local Iron Fist description from 2D6 to 2D10.
automation.demonHunterInitiationHint: Give characters with Demon Hunter Initiation unlimited sight in darkness while preserving their existing token vision presentation settings.
automation.frostreaperHint: Show a light-blue 10 m visual reminder aura after Frostreaper is activated. The aura lasts until the Death Knight's turn in the next round. Movement and BUSHCRAFT remain manual.
automation.deathKnightRunesHint: Show and manage the rune engraved through Death Knight's Rebirth. Fallen Crusader and Razorice remain manual reminders; Unending Thirst adds +2 Movement while its selected melee weapon is wielded.
automation.druidFormsHint: Automate Druid incarnation forms and associated configurable form artwork.
automation.druidFormMovementHint: Double Movement while Travel Form is active. Water movement, underwater breathing, SWIMMING, and flight remain manual rules.
automation.druidFormAttackHint: Create temporary Maul/Shred natural attacks in Bear/Cat Form and prevent use of other weapons while transformed.
automation.druidFormArmorHint: Suppress humanoid armor and helmets while transformed. Bear Form uses Ironfur at Armor 3 x PL and Tree Form uses Barkskin at Armor 2 x PL.
automation.druidFormSpellRestrictionHint: In Travel, Bear, and Cat Form, only spells whose requirement is Word alone can be cast.
automation.druidMoonkinSpellCostHint: While Moonkin Form is active, magic tricks cost 0 WP and other spells cost 1 WP less per Stars Incarnation power level, minimum 1 WP.
automation.druidFormArtworkHint: Automatically switch Druid portraits and tokens when forms change, while preserving each humanoid and scene-token image.

developer.menuHint: Development-only diagnostics. This menu is available only in branch development packages.
developer.druidLifecycleTraceHint: Trace Druid lifecycle requests, document propagation, and token refreshes on this client. Disabled by default.
developer.traceExportHint: When tracing is enabled, copy the buffer from the browser console with copy(boaExportDruidTrace()). Clear it with boaClearDruidTrace().
